name: Rohan Mehta
text: Bought the Beast Crawler X10 for my son's birthday. Quality is insane and delivery was 3 days flat. Ordering on WhatsApp was super easy.

name: Aditi Sharma
text: DIG & DRIVE ARENA has the best collection of RC excavators in India. The team helped me pick the right model over chat. Highly recommend!

name: Karthik Iyer
text: Got two drift cars and a monster truck. Packaging was premium, everything worked out of the box. My new go-to hobby store.
